Definition: from G3844 and G1622; near outside, i.e. besides:--except, saving, without.
BiblicalUsage: Parektos means except, besides, without. Jesus says in Matthew 5:32 that a man who puts away his wife, saving for the cause of fornication, causes her to commit adultery. Paul wishes in Acts 26:29 that Agrippa and all who hear him were such as he is, except these bonds.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the exception in a command matters as much as the command, and Paul's except is the mark of a free man who would give his freedom to everyone but his chains to no one.
